How FLOP is governed

Validators are the guardians of the network, and they govern it through FLOP Improvement Proposals (FIPs).

The mechanism

FIPs are the on-chain governance mechanism. On a FIP, the active validator set votes, and in most cases two-thirds must approve before implementation begins.

Who may propose

Through the first halving, only the FLOP Foundation may submit a FIP.

What governance can change

Governance holds the dials the security argument depends on. The audit rate and the stake size are explicitly substitutable, and governance can raise either until honesty is the only profitable strategy — see the challenge game.
